mapper.sql: SELECT ASMT.ASMT_ID , ASMT.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , ( SELECT LCTR_WKNONM FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = ASMT.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID ) AS LCTR_WKNONM , ASMT.ASMT_GRP_ID , ASMT.ASMT_TTL , ASMT.ASMT_CTS , ASMT.ASMT_GBNCD , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND UP_CD = 'ASMT_GBNCD' AND CD = ASMT.ASMT_GBNCD) AS ASMT_GBNNM , ASMT.DVCLAS_NO , ASMT.TEAM_GRP_ID , ASMT.SBASMT_TYCD , ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD , ( SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND UP_CD = 'EVL_SCR_TYCD' AND CD = ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD ) AS EVL_SCR_TYNM , ASMT.RUBRIC_ID , (SELECT RUBRIC_TTL FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC WHERE RUBRIC_ID = ASMT.RUBRIC_ID) AS RUBRIC_TTL , ASMT.DELYN , ASMT.SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD , ASMT.ASMT_OYN , ASMT.ASMT_PRCTCYN , ASMT.AVG_SCR_OYN , ASMT.PUSH_ALIMYN , ASMT.DVCLAS_CNCRNT_REGYN , ASMT.INDV_ASMTYN , ASMT.TEAM_ASMT_STNGYN , ASMT.TMBR_INDIV_SBMSN_PRMYN , ASMT.MRK_RFLTYN , ASMT.MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.MRK_OYN , ASMT.MRK_INQ_SDTTM , CASE WHEN ASMT.MRK_OYN = 'Y' AND FN_DTTM() >= ASMT.MRK_INQ_SDTTM THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MRK_INQ_PSBL_YN , ASMT.MRK_INQ_EDTTM , ASMT.EVL_USEYN , ASMT.EVL_SDTTM , ASMT.EVL_EDTTM , ASMT.EVL_RSLT_OYN , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OYN , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_SDTTM , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_EDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.RGTR_ID , ASMT.REG_DTTM , ASMT.MDFR_ID , ASMT.MOD_DTTM , ASMT.SBJCT_ID , ASMT.EXLN_ASMT_DWLDYN , ASMT.BYTEAM_ASMT_USEYN , ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID , ASMT.TEAM_ASMT_OYN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtEvlScrModify 설 명 : 과제 평가 점수 수정 */
MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL ASMT_EVL USING ( SELECT USR.* , ROUND( USR.SCR * CASE WHEN NVL(SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD, USR.SBMSN_STSCD) = 'EXTD_SBMSN_CMPTN' THEN NVL(ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT, 100) WHEN NVL(SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD, USR.SBMSN_STSCD) = 'RESBMSN_CMPTN' THEN NVL(ASMT.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT, 100) ELSE 100 END / 100 , 2 ) AS RFLT_SCR FROM ( SELECT #{asmtEvlId} AS ASMT_EVL_ID , #{asmtId} AS ASMT_ID , #{asmtSbmsnId} AS ASMT_SBMSN_ID , #{sbmsnStscd} AS SBMSN_STSCD , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID , TO_NUMBER(#{scr}) AS SCR , #{rgtrId} AS RGTR_ID , #{mdfrId} AS MDFR_ID FROM DUAL ) USR LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN ON SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = USR.ASMT_SBMSN_ID AND SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT ON ASMT.ASMT_ID = USR.ASMT_ID ) USR ON ( ASMT_EVL.ASMT_ID = USR.ASMT_ID AND ASMT_EVL.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ASMT_EVL.SCR = CASE WHEN USR.RFLT_SCR < 0 THEN 0 WHEN USR.RFLT_SCR > 100 THEN 100 ELSE USR.RFLT_SCR END , ASMT_EVL.ASMT_SBMSN_ID = USR.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , ASMT_EVL.EVLYN = 'Y' , ASMT_EVL.MDFR_ID = USR.MDFR_ID , ASMT_EVL.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ASMT_EVL_ID , ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SCR , EVLYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , ASMT_ID , USER_ID , TEAM_ID ) VALUES ( USR.ASMT_EVL_ID , USR.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , CASE WHEN USR.RFLT_SCR < 0 THEN 0 WHEN USR.RFLT_SCR > 100 THEN 100 ELSE USR.RFLT_SCR END , 'Y' , USR.RGTR_ID , FN_DTTM() , USR.ASMT_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.TEAM_ID )

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.resetMrkRfltrt 설 명 : 성적반영비율 재정렬 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT USING ( WITH BASE AS ( SELECT A.ASMT_ID , A.REG_DTTM , A.MRK_RFLTYN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT A WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = ( SELECT CURR.SBJCT_ID FROM TB_LMS_ASMT CURR WHERE CURR.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} ) AND A.DELYN = 'N' AND A.ASMT_GBNCD NOT LIKE '%SBST%' AND A.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL ) , APPLIED AS ( SELECT B.ASMT_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY B.REG_DTTM , B.ASMT_ID ) RN , COUNT(*) OVER() CNT FROM BASE B WHERE B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' ) SELECT B.ASMT_ID , CASE WHEN B.MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN A.RN = 1 THEN TRUNC(100 / A.CNT) + MOD(100, A.CNT) ELSE TRUNC(100 / A.CNT) END ELSE 0 END AS MRK_RFLTRT FROM BASE B LEFT JOIN APPLIED A ON A.ASMT_ID = B.ASMT_ID ) SRC ON ( ASMT.ASMT_ID = SRC.ASMT_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ASMT.MRK_RFLTRT = SRC.MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , ASMT.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM()

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.resetAsmtEvlScrByRubricModify 설 명 : 루브릭 내용 수정 시 해당 루브릭 사용 과제 평가점수 초기화 */ UPDATE TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL SET EVL.SCR = NULL , EVL.EVLYN = 'N' , EVL.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , EVL.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT WHERE ASMT.ASMT_ID = EVL.ASMT_ID AND ASMT.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} AND ASMT.DELYN = 'N' )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.subAsmtList 설 명 : 하위 부과제 목록 조회 */ SELECT ASMT_ID , UP_ASMT_ID , SBJCT_ID , DVCLAS_NO FROM TB_LMS_ASMT WHERE UP_ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND DELYN = 'N'

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtSelect 설 명 : 과제 조회 */ SELECT MAIN.* , GRP.TEAM_GRPNM FROM (
) MAIN LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP GRP ON GRP.TEAM_GRP_ID = MAIN.TEAM_GRP_ID AND GRP.SBJCT_ID = MAIN.SBJCT_ID WHERE MAIN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId}

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.dvclasList 설 명 : 분반 목록 */ WITH BASE AS ( SELECT SBJCT_ID , PROF_ID , SMSTR_CHRT_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' ) SELECT SBJCT.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , SBJCT.PROF_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN BASE ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = BASE.SMSTR_CHRT_ID AND SBJCT.PROF_ID = BASE.PROF_ID WHERE SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.teamGrpTeamList 설 명 : 학습그룹별 팀 목록 + 부과제 조회 */ SELECT TEAM.TEAM_ID , TEAM.TEAMNM , TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID , LEADER.USERNM AS LEADERNM , NVL(TEAM_MBR_CNT.TEAM_MBR_CNT, 0) AS TEAM_MBR_CNT , SUB_ASMT.ASMT_ID , SUB_ASMT.ASMT_TTL , SUB_ASMT.ASMT_CTS , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(SUB_ASMT.ASMT_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID , COUNT(*) AS TEAM_MBR_CNT FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR TEAM_MBR GROUP BY TEAM_MBR.TEAM_ID ) TEAM_MBR_CNT ON TEAM_MBR_CNT.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR LEADER_MBR ON LEADER_MBR.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID AND LEADER_MBR.LDRYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER LEADER ON LEADER.USER_ID = LEADER_MBR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRGT.TEAM_ID , ASMT.ASMT_ID , ASMT.ASMT_TTL , ASMT.ASMT_CTS FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT ON TRGT.ASMT_ID = ASMT.ASMT_ID WHERE ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID = #{upAsmtId} AND ASMT.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY TRGT.TEAM_ID , ASMT.ASMT_ID , ASMT.ASMT_TTL , ASMT.ASMT_CTS ) SUB_ASMT ON SUB_ASMT.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID WHERE TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId} AND TEAM.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' ORDER BY TEAM.TEAMNM
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtRegist 설 명 : 과제 등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_LMS_ASMT ( ASMT_ID , LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , SBJCT_ID , UP_ASMT_ID , ASMT_GRP_ID , ASMT_TTL , ASMT_CTS , ASMT_GBNCD , DVCLAS_NO , TEAM_GRP_ID , SBASMT_TYCD , EVL_SCR_TYCD , RUBRIC_ID , DELYN , SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD , ASMT_PRCTCYN , DVCLAS_CNCRNT_REGYN , INDV_ASMTYN , TEAM_ASMT_STNGYN , TMBR_INDIV_SBMSN_PRMYN , MRK_RFLTYN , MRK_RFLTRT , MRK_OYN , MRK_INQ_SDTTM , MRK_INQ_EDTTM , SBASMT_OSTD_OYN , SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_SDTTM , SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_EDTTM , RESBMSN_SDTTM , RESBMSN_EDTTM , RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN , EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , EXLN_ASMT_DWLDYN , BYTEAM_ASMT_USEYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{asmtId} , #{lctrWknoSchdlId} , #{sbjctId} , #{upAsmtId} , #{asmtGrpId} , #{asmtTtl} , #{asmtCts} , #{asmtGbncd} , #{dvclasNo} , #{teamGrpId} , #{sbasmtTycd} , #{evlScrTycd} , #{rubricId} , 'N' , #{sbmsnFileMimeTycd} , NVL(#{asmtPrctcyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{dvclasCncrntRegyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{indvAsmtyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{teamAsmtStngyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{tmbrIndivSbmsnPrmyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{mrkRfltyn}, 'N') , 0 , NVL(#{mrkOyn}, 'N') , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{mrkInqSdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{mrkInqEdttm}) , NVL(#{sbasmtOstdOyn}, 'N') , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{sbasmtOstdOpenSdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{sbasmtOstdOpenEdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{resbmsnSdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{resbmsnEdttm}) , NVL(#{resbmsnMrkRfltrt}, 0) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{asmtSbmsnSdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{asmtSbmsnEdttm}) , NVL(#{extdSbmsnPrmyn}, 'N') , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{extdSbmsnSdttm}) , FN_DTTM_FORMAT(#{extdSbmsnEdttm}) , #{extdSbmsnMrkRfltrt} , NVL(#{exlnAsmtDwldyn}, 'N') , NVL(#{byteamAsmtUseyn}, 'N') , #{rgtrId} , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.allStdTrgtList 설 명 : 전체 수강 대상 조회 */ SELECT USR.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID WHERE ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND USR.USER_STSCD = 'ACTV'
/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtCopySmstrChrtList 설 명 : 이전과제 가져오기 학기기수 목록 조회 */ SELECT SMSTR_CHRT_ID , SMSTR_CHRTNM FROM TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT WHERE ORG_ID = #{orgId}

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtCopySbjctList 설 명 : 이전과제 가져오기 과목 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.SBJCT_ID , A.SBJCTNM , A.DVCLAS_NO FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT A JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT B ON A.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE B.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = #{smstrChrtId} AND A.DELYN = 'N' AND A.USEYN = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM WHERE SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF' AND USER_ID = (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF') )

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtRubricEvlList 설 명 : 과제 루브릭 평가 목록 */ SELECT QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID AS RUBRIC_QSTN_ID , QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_TTL AS RUBRIC_QSTN_TTL , QSTN.EVLRT , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_ID AS RUBRIC_VWITM_ID , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_TTL AS RUBRIC_VWITM_TTL , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT AS RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT , 'N' AS SELECTED_YN FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_QSTN QSTN JOIN TB_LMS_RUBRIC_VWITM VWITM ON VWITM.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID = QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID WHERE QSTN.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} ORDER BY QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_SEQNO , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_SEQNO

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.asmtRubricEvlScoreList 설 명 : 과제 루브릭 평가 점수 계산 데이터 조회 */ SELECT SCORE.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID , SCORE.RUBRIC_VWITM_ID , SCORE.EVLRT , SCORE.RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT , SCORE.MAX_RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT FROM ( /* * 문항별 최대점수는 선택한 보기만 필터링하기 전에 계산한다. * 필터링 후 MAX를 계산하면 선택 점수가 최대점수로 잡혀 만점 처리된다. */ SELECT QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID AS RUBRIC_QSTN_ID , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_ID AS RUBRIC_VWITM_ID , QSTN.EVLRT , VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT AS RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT , MAX(VWITM.RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT) OVER(PARTITION BY QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID) AS MAX_RUBRIC_VWITM_PNT FROM TB_LMS_RUBRIC_QSTN QSTN JOIN TB_LMS_RUBRIC_VWITM VWITM ON VWITM.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID = QSTN.RUBRIC_QSTN_ID WHERE QSTN.RUBRIC_ID = #{rubricId} ) SCORE WHERE SCORE.RUBRIC_VWITM_ID IN
#{rubricVwitmId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.subAsmtByCopyRegist 설 명 : 부과제 복사 등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_LMS_ASMT ( ASMT_ID , LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , UP_ASMT_ID , SBJCT_ID , DVCLAS_NO , ASMT_GBNCD , ASMT_TTL , ASMT_CTS , ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN , EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM , EXTD_SBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , MRK_RFLTYN , MRK_OYN , EVL_SCR_TYCD , SBASMT_TYCD , SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD , ASMT_PRCTCYN , EXLN_ASMT_DWLDYN , TEAM_ASMT_STNGYN , INDV_ASMTYN , SBASMT_OSTD_OYN , SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_SDTTM , SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_EDTTM , ASMT_GRP_ID , TEAM_GRP_ID , RUBRIC_ID , DVCLAS_CNCRNT_REGYN , TMBR_INDIV_SBMSN_PRMYN , MRK_INQ_SDTTM , MRK_INQ_EDTTM , RESBMSN_SDTTM , RESBMSN_EDTTM , RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , BYTEAM_ASMT_USEYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) SELECT #{asmtId} , ASMT.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , #{upAsmtId} , #{sbjctId} , #{dvclasNo} , ASMT.ASMT_GBNCD , #{asmtTtl} , #{asmtCts} , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.MRK_RFLTYN , ASMT.MRK_OYN , ASMT.EVL_SCR_TYCD , ASMT.SBASMT_TYCD , ASMT.SBMSN_FILE_MIME_TYCD , ASMT.ASMT_PRCTCYN , ASMT.EXLN_ASMT_DWLDYN , ASMT.TEAM_ASMT_STNGYN , ASMT.INDV_ASMTYN , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OYN , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_SDTTM , ASMT.SBASMT_OSTD_OPEN_EDTTM , ASMT.ASMT_GRP_ID , ASMT.TEAM_GRP_ID , ASMT.RUBRIC_ID , ASMT.DVCLAS_CNCRNT_REGYN , ASMT.TMBR_INDIV_SBMSN_PRMYN , ASMT.MRK_INQ_SDTTM , ASMT.MRK_INQ_EDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_SDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_EDTTM , ASMT.RESBMSN_MRK_RFLTRT , ASMT.BYTEAM_ASMT_USEYN , #{rgtrId} , FN_DTTM() FROM TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT WHERE ASMT.ASMT_ID = #{upAsmtId}
mapper.select:
/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.stdntAsmtView 설 명 : 학생 과제 상세 조회 */ SELECT MAIN.* , CD.CDNM AS SBMSN_STSNM FROM ( SELECT ROOT_ASMT.* , TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS TARGET_ASMT_ID , TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_TTL AS TARGET_ASMT_TTL , TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_CTS AS TARGET_ASMT_CTS , TRGT.ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , TRGT.TEAM_ID , TRGT.RESBMSN_PRMYN , TEAM.TEAMNM , MBR.LDRYN , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , CASE WHEN ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM IS NULL OR ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM IS NULL THEN 'BEFORE' WHEN FN_DTTM() < ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM THEN 'BEFORE' WHEN FN_DTTM() BETWEEN ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_SDTTM AND ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM THEN 'PROGRESS' WHEN NVL(ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') = 'Y' AND ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM IS NOT NULL AND FN_DTTM() > ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM AND FN_DTTM() <= ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM AND ( ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM IS NULL OR FN_DTTM() >= ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM ) THEN 'EXT_PROGRESS' WHEN NVL(TRGT.RESBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') = 'Y' AND ROOT_ASMT.RESBMSN_SDTTM IS NOT NULL AND ROOT_ASMT.RESBMSN_EDTTM IS NOT NULL AND FN_DTTM() BETWEEN ROOT_ASMT.RESBMSN_SDTTM AND ROOT_ASMT.RESBMSN_EDTTM THEN 'RESBMSN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS ASMT_PRGRS_STS , CASE WHEN SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID IS NOT NULL THEN SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD WHEN NVL(TRGT.RESBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'NON_RESBMSN' WHEN NVL(ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') = 'Y' AND ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_EDTTM IS NOT NULL AND FN_DTTM() > ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_SBMSN_EDTTM AND ( ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM IS NULL OR FN_DTTM() >= ROOT_ASMT.EXTD_SBMSN_SDTTM ) THEN 'EXTD_NON_SBMSN' ELSE 'NON_SBMSN' END AS SBMSN_STSCD , EVL.ASMT_EVL_ID , EVL.SCR , NVL(EVL.EVLYN, 'N') AS EVLYN , NVL(FDBK.FDBK_CNT, 0) AS FDBK_CNT FROM (
) ROOT_ASMT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT TARGET_ASMT ON ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = NVL(TARGET_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID) AND TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND TARGET_ASMT.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT ON TRGT.ASMT_ID = TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID AND TRGT.USER_ID = #{userId} JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = TARGET_ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM ON TEAM.TEAM_ID = TRGT.TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR ON MBR.TEAM_ID = TRGT.TEAM_ID AND MBR.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY SBMSN.ASMT_ID, SBMSN.USER_ID ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN WHERE SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' ) SBMSN ON SBMSN.ASMT_ID = TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID AND SBMSN.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND SBMSN.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_EVL EVL ON EVL.ASMT_ID = TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID AND EVL.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FDBK.ASMT_ID , FDBK.USER_ID , COUNT(*) AS FDBK_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_FDBK FDBK WHERE FDBK.DELYN = 'N' GROUP BY FDBK.ASMT_ID , FDBK.USER_ID ) FDBK ON FDBK.ASMT_ID = TARGET_ASMT.ASMT_ID AND FDBK.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID WHERE ROOT_ASMT.DELYN = 'N' AND ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_OYN = 'Y' ) MAIN LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CD.UP_CD = 'SBMSN_STSCD' AND CD.CD = MAIN.SBMSN_STSCD

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.stdntAsmtAlimInfo 설 명 : 학생 과제 알림 정보 조회 */ SELECT USR.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , USR.USE_EML_GBNCD , CNTCT.MBL_PHN AS MOBILE_NO , CASE WHEN USR.USE_EML_GBNCD = 'LNKG' THEN CNTCT.LNKG_EML ELSE CNTCT.INDV_EML END AS EMAIL , CNTCT.LNKG_EML , CNTCT.INDV_EML FROM TB_LMS_USER USR LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' THEN CNTCT END) AS MBL_PHN , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'LNKG_EML' THEN CNTCT END) AS LNKG_EML , MAX(CASE WHEN CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' THEN CNTCT END) AS INDV_EML FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT GROUP BY USER_ID ) CNTCT ON CNTCT.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.stdntAsmtSbmsnList 설 명 : 학생 과제 제출목록 조회 */ SELECT SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID , SBMSN.ASMT_ID , SBMSN.USER_ID , SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM , SBMSN.SBMSN_TYCD , SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD , CD.CDNM AS SBMSN_STSNM , SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT , CASE WHEN SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LENGTH(SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT) > 30 THEN SUBSTR(SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT, 1, 30) || '...' ELSE SBMSN.SBMSN_TXT END AS SBMSN_TXT_SUMMARY , FN_REF_FILE_CNT(SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID) AS FILE_CNT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC ) AS LINE_NO FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN SBMSN JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT ON TRGT.ASMT_ID = SBMSN.ASMT_ID AND TRGT.USER_ID = SBMSN.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_CMMN_CD CD ON CD.LANG_CD = NVL(#{langCd}, 'ko') AND CD.UP_CD = 'SBMSN_STSCD' AND CD.CD = SBMSN.SBMSN_STSCD WHERE SBMSN.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND SBMSN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SBMSN.DELYN = 'N' ORDER BY SBMSN.SBMSN_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.REG_DTTM DESC , SBMSN.ASMT_SBMSN_ID DESC

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.stdntAsmtSbmsnTargetList 설 명 : 학생 과제 제출 저장 대상 조회 */ SELECT TRGT.USER_ID , USR.USERNM , TRGT.TEAM_ID FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ASMT ON ASMT.ASMT_ID = TRGT.ASMT_ID AND ASMT.DELYN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID WHERE TRGT.ASMT_ID = #{asmtId} AND ( ( ASMT.TEAM_ASMT_STNGYN = 'Y' AND NVL(ASMT.TMBR_INDIV_SBMSN_PRMYN, 'N') != 'Y' AND TRGT.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ) OR TRGT.USER_ID = #{userId} ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRGT.USER_ID = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , TRGT.USER_ID

/* SQL ID : AsmtDAO.lctrWknoSchdlList 설 명 : 강의주차일정 목록 */ SELECT LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , LCTR_WKNO_CD , LCTR_WKNONM , CASE WHEN FN_DT() BETWEEN LCTR_WKNO_SYMD AND LCTR_WKNO_EYMD THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CURR_WKNO_YN FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ORDER BY LCTR_WKNO_SEQNO
